verse.verse_1: I CALL TO witness the dawn
verse.verse_5: Is there not an evidence in this for those who have sense?
verse.verse_6: Have you not seen what your Lord did to the 'Ad
verse.verse_7: Of Eram with lofty pillars (erected as signposts in the desert),
verse.verse_8: The like of whom were never created in the realm;
verse.verse_9: And with Thamud who carved rocks in the valley;
verse.verse_13: So your Lord poured a scourge of punishment over them.
verse.verse_14: Your Lord is certainly in wait.
verse.verse_15: As for man, whenever his Lord tries him and then is gracious and provides good things for him, he says: "My Lord has been gracious to me."
verse.verse_16: But when He tries him by restraining his means, he says: "My Lord despises me."
verse.verse_17: No. In fact you are not generous to the orphans,
verse.verse_18: Nor do you urge one another to feed the poor,
verse.verse_20: And love wealth with all your heart.
verse.verse_21: Surely when We pound the earth to powder grounded, pounded to dust,
verse.verse_22: And comes your Lord, and angels row on row,
verse.verse_23: And Hell is brought near, that day will man remember, but of what avail will then remembering be?
verse.verse_24: He will say: "Alas the woe! Would that I had sent ahead something in my life."
verse.verse_25: None can punish as He will punish on that day,
verse.verse_26: And none can bind as He will bind.
verse.verse_28: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and well-pleasing Him.
